The real interest rate is denoted by r and the nominal rate by i, with i 1⁄4 r þ pe. Let the central bank implement policy by setting i to minimize the expected value of 1 2 1⁄2lðy kÞ 2 þ p2, where k > 0. Assume that the policy authority has forecasts e f , u f , and v f of the shocks but that the public forms its expectations prior to the setting of i and without any information on the shocks.
